title: Windsurf vs Cline: Which AI Coding Tool Should Developers Use?
summary: Windsurf vs Cline compared honestly: AI IDE vs open-source VS Code agent. Pricing, model support, workflow — plus the full-stack option most builders end up using.
body_markdown: Both tools handle large repos, but differently. Windsurf uses its SWE-1 model with full-codebase context automatically loaded. Cline explicitly reads files you reference in your prompt and shows you exactly which files it's loading — more transparent, slightly more manual. For very large enterprise codebases with strict data residency requirements, Cline's local-first model (nothing leaves your network unless you configure it) is often the stronger choice.[Blink](https://blink.new/) is optimized for net-new app construction rather than managing large existing codebases, so it's most valuable when you're starting fresh or spinning up a new service.
